semiconductor_relevance: High — TRUST CLEAN TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD. provides critical vacuum components and accessories used in semiconductor fabrication processes.
summary: TRUST CLEAN TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD. specializes in manufacturing vacuum components, fittings, and valves essential for semiconductor fabrication. Their products include gaskets, seals, O-rings, and a variety of plumbing fittings, as well as vacuum system components like optical monitors and sputtering target fixtures.
